comment: The design of the weld symbol UI test (mitcad#2350; tools/ui-drawing-weld-test.sh): a two-member frame of the mitering test's synthetic 20 mm square profile (tools/ui-scripts/build-end-meets-profile.json, its library LIBRARY_URL replaced by the test). Upright (C1) stands at the origin, 500 long; Arm (C2), 300 long, stands with its end A on the upright's y+ side from offset 240, so it runs along +y from y = 10 at z = 240 to 260: a T joint. Drawing1 (D1, A3) has its right view at 1:5 with the frame's box in the middle at (200, 150): the model's (y, z) on the sheet at (170 + y / 5, 100 + z / 5); the arm's top edge at sheet y 152 from x 172 to 232, its bottom edge at y 148, its end on the upright's side at x 172. All geometry is synthetic.
